references.text: The men of the tribe of Ephraim also quarreled with Gideon after his victory over the Midianites, making the same accusation that they had not been called to battle.
Describes Jephthah's victory over the Ammonites which triggered the complaint from the tribe of Ephraim.
Reference to a northward movement in connection with the tribes and their geographical location.
A similar threat to burn down a house with fire was made against Samson's wife.
The Philistines actually carried out a burning as punishment, showing the seriousness of such threats during the time of the Judges.
